description: On a `git commit`, checks the commit message and branch name for a ticket reference (task-cli id, GitHub issue #123, Closes/Fixes #N, Linear ABC-123). If none is found and the commit isn't an exempt chore/WIP/merge, it BLOCKS by default (strict) — non-trivial changes should start from a ticket with acceptance criteria + motivation + user-impact. Deliberate escapes: a `[skip-ticket: <reason>]` commit-message trailer, an inline `REQUIRE_TICKET_SKIP=1 git commit`, or REQUIRE_TICKET_STRICT=0 to opt back to warn-only. Enforces the strict-ticket-discipline skill; pairs with task-cli. on_error=open: a CRASH in the check still fails open so a bug never wedges committing — but a successful no-ticket run is a hard block.
